prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Persistence Warning Hint: Display a helpful warning hint on the sign-in screen reminding returning users to sign in with their original provider to recover existing pet data.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Use your original login method to keep and restore your saved pet and progress."}}
1: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Split Layout Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen into a clear split layout highlighting pre-made vs custom pet options side by side.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion Path", "body": "Select a ready-to-adopt pet for fast setup, or create a custom pet from your own photos."}}
2: [adoption, new_screen] Adoption Photo Preview Screen: Add a dedicated photo review screen after photo upload so users can check photo quality before starting pet creation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_photo_preview", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_photo_preview": {"headline": "Review Your Pet Photos", "body": "Ensure your photos are clear and well-lit for optimal 3D pet generation.", "layout": "centered", "button_label": "Confirm & Generate"}}
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Tip Carousel: Add an auto-rotating tip carousel on the waiting screen explaining basic desktop pet shortcuts while files compile.
   config: {"waiting": {"tip_delay_seconds": 5, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "rounded", "action": "next", "text": "Tip: Right-click your pet on desktop anytime to bring up quick action controls."}]}}
4: [finish, layout] Home Intro Card Layout Overhaul: Change the home intro screen layout to card style featuring clear visual instructions on desktop pet placement and controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Your Pet is Live on Desktop!", "hint": "Click and drag your pet to move it around your desktop screens."}}
5: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Focused Card Layout Redesign: Rebuild the sign-in screen into a clean centered card layout with prominent single-click sign-in buttons.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Sign In to Save Your Progress", "replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"type": "button", "label": "Sign In with Google", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next", "role": "sign_in_options"}]}}}
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Clarity Guidance Hint: Add clear image specification hints directly on the photo upload screen explaining proper photo angles and lighting.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use bright, evenly lit frontal photos without direct glare for the best custom pet results."}}
7: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Controls Checklist Finish Flow: Reframe the final onboarding step into a brief interactive checklist layout introducing core desktop pet interactions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Desktop Pet Quick Start", "body": "Here is how to interact with your pet on your desktop:", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "style": "rounded", "text": "Right-click pet to access settings & sleep mode"}]}}
8: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Action Copy Clarification: Update headline and button wording on the path selection screen to set clear expectations for the next step.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select Your Adoption Experience", "button_label": "Continue to Sign In"}}
9: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Generation Status Badge: Add an explicit progress badge and readiness notification switch to the waiting screen to inform users during model building.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Building 3D pet models...", "style": "highlight"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Adding a sign-in persistence hint is valid and does not break any base rules.
Redesigns choose_path into a split layout while preserving both adoption and custom pet options.
Adding a new photo preview screen within onboarding is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.
Adding an educational tip carousel to the waiting screen complies with onboarding modification rules.
Redesigning the home intro overlay layout is permitted under Rule 4.
Redesigning the sign-in layout while maintaining sign-in functionality is allowed.
Adding image guidance hints to the photo upload screen is valid.
Reframing home intro into an interactive checklist layout is allowed within onboarding.
Updating text copy on the path selection screen complies with all base rules.
Adding status badges and notification options on the waiting screen is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.
